name: ZTP riboswitch bound to UG4 (pyridine-imidazole analog)
notes: ZTP riboswitch with UG4 (5-amino-1-(pyridin-3-yl)-1H-imidazole-4-carboxamide, MW 203) at 3.23 Å. Simplified ZTP analog without phosphate tail. Heteroaromatic rings test baseStacking term. Mg present in binding site. Chain A used (2 chains). Ref: Kim et al. 2020 PNAS.
